findings.highlight: This desolate land
findings.evidenceJa: 他人のいない一面の荒野
findings.governingReading: a wasteland stretching everywhere with no other people in it
findings.explanation: The cruel contrast between fighting for others and receiving a world without others disappears.

findings.highlight: in this place
findings.evidenceJa: この風景を抱いたまま
findings.governingReading: while carrying this landscape within himself
findings.explanation: Archer’s inner world becomes merely the physical location where he died.

findings.highlight: the fate to be summoned as a “guardian” after his death.
findings.evidenceJa: 死んだ後も“守護者”として使役される運命
findings.governingReading: the fate of being used in servitude as a Guardian even after death
findings.explanation: The defining endless exploitation disappears, leaving only neutral summoning.

findings.highlight: they sublimate into something other that what they used to be
findings.evidenceJa: 人間だった頃とは別の物に昇華する。
findings.governingReading: they are sublimated into something different from what they were as humans
findings.explanation: The metaphysical transformation is expressed with malformed comparative grammar.

findings.highlight: gave his body after his death
findings.evidenceJa: 死後の自分を差し出して
findings.governingReading: offered up his posthumous self
findings.explanation: The totality of Archer’s future self and agency is narrowed to a corpse or body.

findings.highlight: Steel is my body, and fire is my blood.
findings.evidenceJa: 血潮は鉄で　心は硝子。
findings.governingReading: His blood is iron and his heart is glass.
findings.explanation: The verse’s bodily and emotional materials are replaced with a different chant variant.

findings.highlight: I have created over a thousand blades.
findings.evidenceJa: 幾たびの戦場を越えて不敗。
findings.governingReading: He crosses countless battlefields undefeated.
findings.explanation: A history of undefeated passage through battlefields is replaced by a weapon count absent from this verse.

findings.highlight: Unknown to Death.
findings.evidenceJa: ただの一度も敗走はなく
findings.governingReading: Not once did he retreat in defeat.
findings.explanation: Absence of rout or retreat is replaced by a statement about death.

findings.highlight: Nor known to Life.
findings.evidenceJa: ただの一度も理解されない。
findings.governingReading: Not once was he understood.
findings.explanation: Archer’s lifelong lack of human understanding is replaced by an abstract line about life.

findings.highlight: Have withstood pain to create many weapons.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の者は常に独り　剣の丘で勝利に酔う。
findings.governingReading: He is always alone, intoxicated with victory upon the hill of swords.
findings.explanation: Solitude and bitter intoxication with victory are replaced by pain endured to manufacture weapons.

findings.highlight: Yet, those hands will never hold anything.
findings.evidenceJa: 故に、生涯に意味はなく。
findings.governingReading: Therefore, his whole life had no meaning.
findings.explanation: The verse’s judgment on Archer’s life is replaced by an image of empty hands.

findings.highlight: So as I pray, unlimited blade works.
findings.evidenceJa: その体は、きっと剣で出来ていた。
findings.governingReading: That body was surely made of swords.
findings.explanation: The conjectural, past-tense return to Archer’s body is replaced with prayer and the Reality Marble’s English title.

findings.highlight: he ended up cursing his life.
findings.evidenceJa: かつての自分の生き方そのものを呪うようになった
findings.governingReading: he came to curse the very way his former self had lived
findings.explanation: Archer’s rejection of his earlier ideals and conduct becomes condemnation of his entire life.

findings.highlight: I’m not as loose as Emiya Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎ほど甘くはない
findings.governingReading: I am not as naive or softhearted as Emiya Shirou
findings.explanation: Rin’s contrast with Shirou’s idealistic softness becomes a claim about looseness.

findings.highlight: I won’t give it up no matter who’s telling me so
findings.evidenceJa: 相手が何者であろうと、それを譲る気なんかない
findings.governingReading: No matter who the opponent may be, I have no intention of yielding it.
findings.explanation: The identity of whoever opposes Rin becomes someone verbally instructing her.

findings.highlight: I will believe in my path
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の信じた道を貫き通す。
findings.governingReading: I will follow the path I believe in through to the end.
findings.explanation: Rin’s vow of sustained action becomes private belief.

findings.highlight: It goes the same for my legs
findings.evidenceJa: 足首も同様
findings.governingReading: her ankles are restrained in the same way
findings.explanation: The restraint location expands from the ankles to the whole legs.

findings.highlight: are magic resistant
findings.evidenceJa: 抗魔術がかけられていて
findings.governingReading: have anti-Magecraft applied to them
findings.explanation: An imposed counterspell or enchantment becomes an intrinsic material property.

findings.highlight: By the pillar
findings.evidenceJa: 柱の陰
findings.governingReading: in the shadow behind a pillar
findings.explanation: Archer’s concealed position becomes an ordinary location beside the pillar.

findings.highlight: a calm “cleaner”
findings.evidenceJa: 冷徹な“掃除屋”
findings.governingReading: a cold and ruthless “cleaner”
findings.explanation: Archer’s inhuman severity is softened into composure.

findings.highlight: I take a breath and glare at the guy in the shadows.
findings.evidenceJa: それを一息で呑み込んで、強く、影になった男を見据えた。
findings.governingReading: She swallows all that hesitation in one breath and fixes the shadowed man with a resolute gaze.
findings.explanation: Rin’s act of absorbing the consequence and choosing her words becomes merely inhaling and glaring.

findings.highlight: I’m saved by having a guy like him.
findings.evidenceJa: ああいうヤツがいてもいいんだって救われてる
findings.governingReading: she is saved by knowing that someone like him is allowed to exist
findings.explanation: Rin’s affirmation that Shirou’s kind of person has a rightful place in the world becomes personal possession or proximity.
